typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*I am an 18 year old boy, and I am just on my way to visit my grandmother at her house. As soon as I step into the garden, I hear old female voices coming out of the house. When I step in, I immediately greet them, not knowing who is there:* Hellooo Granny! 

*My grandma greets me back:* Hi there sweety! *and then her friends: Maria Kovacs, and Ildiko Horvath, both greet me;* Hello there boy!
typesense:top-rated.name: Grandma’s friends
typesense:top-rated.title: My Grandma, and her 2 friends (Maria Kovacs & Ildiko Horvath)
